task: Fix pi-mcp-bridge cold-start defects (docs/mcp-review-2026-08-10.md, recommended items 1-3). In extensions/index.ts: (1) export an async discoverAll(servers, makeClient, onError?) that runs each server's tools/list CONCURRENTLY (Promise.allSettled-style), returns a Record<name, tools> in CONFIG order (deterministic tool-name collision prefixing depends on registration order), and reports per-server failures via onError without aborting the others; rewire the existing discover() to use it. (2) Change cacheKey to a sha256 hex digest of JSON.stringify([cfg.command, cfg.env]) (node:crypto createHash) so no raw argv/env is persisted; export cacheKey. (3) saveCache must write the file with mode 0o600 even when it already exists (chmod after write if needed); export saveCache and loadCache, each accepting an optional path parameter defaulting to CACHE_FILE. Also add a README.md section documenting cold-start behaviour (parallel discovery, 0600 cache, hashed keys) and the bearer-token wrapper-script pattern for remote servers (token read from an env file by the wrapper, never in argv). acceptance.test.ts is the gate - make it pass WITHOUT editing it. You may add your own unit tests under tests/. Do not add runtime dependencies; node:crypto covers the hash.
rules: acceptance.test.ts is the operator-authored gate; NEVER edit it - change extensions/index.ts to satisfy it.
Make the smallest change that satisfies the sensors; no refactors beyond the three items.
A check satisfied by a stub (throw new Error('not implemented'), TODO markers) is a FAILED iteration.
Do not run git commit / git reset / git checkout -- : the loop owns git state.
